info.name: 覆流年
info.plot: After being betrayed and losing everything in her past life, waterway master Lu Anran is reborn and vows to take revenge. Along the way, she gains an unexpected ally in the ninth prince, Mu Chuan, who cares little for power but chooses to stand by her side. Together, they navigate the treacherous world of imperial politics.

translations.title: 覆流年
translations.overview: 陆家嫡女陆安然与庆王穆泽一见钟情，却落得深情错付无情人、全家惨遭设计的下场，得知真相后，陆安然发誓要保护家人，也终于看清守护在她身边，知己好友穆川的真心……
